responsibility: Owns the shared layout vocabulary for rustc_transmute by wiring together the tree, NFA, and DFA submodules, defining the core byte, definition, reference, and uninhabited marker abstractions they operate on, and exposing rustc-specific adapters for extracting reference metadata and type layouts from compiler types.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `maybe_transmutable/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the shared representation layer: it defines the crate-wide `Byte`, `Def`, `Ref`, and `Uninhabited` abstractions and reexports the `tree`, `nfa`, and `dfa` layout forms, plus rustc-specific layout adapters. It does not run the transmutability decision procedure itself.
